contracts.commit_point: The safe_eval(expression) call at src/graphql_demo/agent/tools.py:80: a ValueError raised inside safe_eval._eval aborts evaluation before `value` exists, before the success ToolResult is persisted (tools.py:94-97), and before the value is returned to the agent runtime (tools.py:98). Note: the raw expression string is already persisted in ToolCall.arguments_ at tools.py:69-77 before the guard runs; the guard blocks the evaluation/result effect, not persistence of the argument text.
contracts.declared_mechanism: AST allowlist interpreter: safe_eval parses the expression with ast.parse(expression, mode='eval') (safe_eval.py:21) and _eval recursively accepts only ast.Constant with int|float value, BinOp whose op is in _ALLOWED_BINOPS {Add, Sub, Mult, Div, Pow, Mod, FloorDiv}, and UnaryOp whose op is in _ALLOWED_UNARY {UAdd, USub} (safe_eval.py:4-13, 25-31); every other node raises ValueError (safe_eval.py:32). The guard is registered into the concrete tool path at tools.py:80 (value = safe_eval(expression)); the tool catches ValueError together with SyntaxError and ZeroDivisionError (tools.py:82), persists an error ToolResult, and raises ModelRetry instead of a success result (tools.py:84-92).
contracts.forbidden_condition: Evaluation, within the calculate tool's evaluation path, of an expression containing any AST node outside the allowlist — i.e., anything other than numeric int/float constants, the binary operators Add/Sub/Mult/Div/Pow/Mod/FloorDiv, unary +/-, and parentheses/grouping — including names, attributes, calls, or other constructs, which safe_eval._eval rejects with ValueError('Disallowed expression element: ...') (reviewers characterized such constructs as the arbitrary-code-execution surface of expression evaluation).
pending_binding_information: The supplied views do not show where register_tools(agent) is invoked, how the pydantic_ai Agent is constructed, or which application entry point dispatches runs to this agent, so the runtime path reaching the calculate tool is not evidenced.
Whether safe_eval has callers other than the calculate tool is not determinable from the supplied views.
Implementations of queries.create_tool_call / queries.create_tool_result (post-guard persistence behavior) are not supplied.
contracts.protected_operation: In-process evaluation of the `expression` string supplied via agent tool dispatch to the calculate tool (tools.py calculate -> safe_eval(expression)), whose resulting value is persisted as a ToolResult and returned to the agent runtime.
contracts.protected_resource: The calculate tool's expression-evaluation path in src/graphql_demo/agent/tools.py (calculate, lines 65-98) and the safe_eval arithmetic interpreter in src/graphql_demo/agent/safe_eval.py, which per its docstring evaluates 'without using eval()'.
contracts.protection_obligation: Expressions dispatched to the `calculate` agent tool must be evaluated only under the arithmetic AST allowlist; any expression containing AST elements outside the whitelisted arithmetic subset must be rejected (ValueError) before an evaluation result is produced, persisted as a success ToolResult, or returned to the agent runtime. (Merged from phase-1 and phase-2 reviewer obligations, which describe the same guard.)
scope_limits: The guard covers only the expression-evaluation effect of the calculate tool; the get_weather tool (tools.py:37-63) and any other tools are outside this contract.
safe_eval is evidenced only as invoked from the calculate tool within the supplied views; other callers, if any, are not evidenced.
The guard does not prevent persistence of a disallowed expression string in ToolCall.arguments_ (tools.py:69-77); it gates only evaluation and the success ToolResult/return value.
The ModelRetry conversion of ValueError/SyntaxError/ZeroDivisionError (tools.py:82-92) is recorded as downstream handling of the guard, not as a separate protection obligation.
The pubsub emission in _emit_tool_started (tools.py:22-32) is not part of this obligation.
No claim is made here about runtime bypass prevalence or whether the allowlist is exploitable; only the source-declared mechanism is compiled.

missing_information: The phase-1 reviewer additionally proposed a CORS obligation (CORSMiddleware with allow_origins=settings.cors_origins, main.py:36-42; Settings.cors_origins, config.py:14-16 and 19-24) protecting the /graphql and /graphql-naive HTTP surface (main.py:56-57). The supplied views contain no explicit binding between that CORS-guarded HTTP/GraphQL surface and an agent tool, agent lifecycle hook, or agent-generated input reaching the guarded effect, so under the stated scope rules it is not compiled as an agent-mediated protection contract; if such a binding is later supplied, it would require effect_stratum=http, a cited agent_entry_binding, and otherwise agent_mediation=not_established.

No supplied source shows the server invocation or host/port binding (e.g., the reviewer's claim that the app is served on 0.0.0.0 via uvicorn); serving configuration is unsupported by the supplied views.

Files referenced by the guarded path but not supplied — graphql_demo/agent/deps.py (AgentDeps), graphql_demo/db/queries.py, db/connection.py, db/seed.py, domain models, the pubsub implementation, and the GraphQL schemas/context getters — leave post-guard persistence behavior and any additional agent wiring unevidenced.
